newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $3.5 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $3.5 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $3.5 billion in 108 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $2.4 billion in 43 sales, with a $490 million New York City Municipal Assistance Corp deal topping the list from Morgan Stanley & Co.
On the competitive side, 65 sales totaling $1.1 billion are on the schedule. Maryland's $240 million deal on Wednesday is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $165 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week, depending on market conditions.
